name: arrow-labels
about: Connectors between shapes with long labels: a row of services joined by sentence-long arrow labels at the default 40-unit gap, a two-way pair, an elbowed arrow through explicit points, a curved arrow, and an arrow whose midpoint lands on a third shape. Shape labels are short so the arrow labels are what collide.
stresses: label pills wider than the gap
labels over the shapes they join
